news.title: Alonso praises 'generous' Caicedo and highlights Henderson's growing connections
news.title_zh: 阿隆索称赞凯塞多“慷慨”，并强调亨德森不断增长的人脉关系
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has underlined the importance of Moises Caicedo to Chelsea’s midfield after confirming the Ecuadorian is fit to face Bournemouth. Caicedo has made only one appearance this season due to injury, but the prolonged pause for international football allowed him to fully recover ahead of the Premier League's return. As a former midfielder, Alonso knows all too well how pivotal the work done in the centre of the pitch is. Our manager detailed the different ways in which Caicedo helps the Blues in that department, while also acknowledging he has room to get even better. ‘With the midfielders, I have a soft spot, and with Moi, for sure,’ Alonso said. ‘We are all happier when we see Moi on the pitch. Not just myself, his team-mates as well. They are happy to see him not just because he’s a great player; everyone loves Moi because of how generous he is with his effort, how much he helps each of the team-mates, and how important he is. ‘He has a very important role in the team because of the balance he gives, because of the many qualities he has, and he's in a moment where he needs to keep growing, to keep learning. ‘I'm really excited about working with him and having him on the pitch and after each game, getting together and seeing the good things, the bad things, to make him feel confident and to make him feel that he's improving his game understanding.’ Our most recent fixture, at Brentford three weeks ago now, was the day Jordan Henderson was handed his Chelsea debut after injury issues of his own. Despite the disappointing result, Henderson didn’t look out of place, and this further break from match action has allowed him to spend more time on the training pitch acclimatising to his team-mates and Alonso’s way of working. ‘He didn't want many days off,’ Alonso said of Henderson’s involvement since the Brentford game. ‘For him it was important to have the feeling of being back on the pitch after missing pre-season, missing the first games, and to feel how his arm was feeling and to have that confidence. ‘It was important to unlock those first minutes on the pitch. That he was playing that tempo, that intensity for 90 minutes, it was good, and I think that now it will be getting better. ‘We need the right players in terms of quality, in terms of personality, and Hendo has great personality, great experience in the league. Now we have had more time with him, he can connect very well with the players.’
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索在确认厄瓜多尔人适合对阵伯恩茅斯后强调了莫伊塞斯·凯塞多对切尔西中场的重要性。凯塞多本赛季因伤只出场一次，但国际比赛的长时间停摆让他在英超联赛回归之前完全康复。作为一名前中场球员，阿隆索非常清楚在球场中央所做的工作有多么关键。我们的经理详细介绍了凯塞多在该部门帮助蓝军的不同方式，同时也承认他还有进步的空间。 “我对中场球员情有独钟，当然对莫伊也情有独钟，”阿隆索说道。 “当我们在球场上看到莫伊时，我们都很高兴。不仅仅是我自己，还有他的队友。他们很高兴见到他，不仅因为他是一名出色的球员；而且因为他是一名出色的球员。每个人都喜欢莫伊，因为他的努力是多么慷慨，他为每个队友提供了多少帮助，以及他是多么重要。 “他在球队中扮演着非常重要的角色，因为他提供了平衡，因为他拥有许多品质，而且他正处于需要不断成长、不断学习的时刻。” “我真的很高兴能和他一起工作，让他在球场上，在每场比赛结束后聚在一起，看到好的事情，坏的事情，让他感到自信，让他感觉自己正在提高自己的比赛理解力。”我们最近的一场比赛是三周前在布伦特福德的比赛，那天乔丹·亨德森在经历了自己的伤病后，完成了他在切尔西的首秀。尽管结果令人失望，但亨德森看起来并没有显得格格不入，这次比赛的进一步休息让他有更多的时间在训练场上适应队友和阿隆索的工作方式。 “他不想休息很多天，”阿隆索在谈到亨德森自布伦特福德比赛以来的参与时说道。 “对他来说，在缺席季前赛、缺席第一场比赛后重新回到球场上的感觉很重要，感受他手臂的感觉并拥有这种信心。 “在球场上的第一分钟就释放出能量是很重要的。他在 90 分钟内一直保持着这样的节奏和强度，这很好，我认为现在会变得更好。 “我们需要在素质和个性方面都合适的球员，而亨多具有出色的个性，在联赛中拥有丰富的经验。现在我们有更多的时间和他在一起，他可以和球员们建立很好的联系。”

news.title: Internationals: England trio victorious, Cuthbert makes return and Blues duo strike
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：英格兰三人组获胜，库斯伯特回归，蓝军二人组进球
news.body_en: Hannah Hampton, Lauren James and Keira Walsh all started as England established a 3-1 first-leg advantage in their 2027 Women's World Cup first-round play-off tie with Greece, while Blues captain Erin Cuthbert returned to action as Scotland overcame the Czech Republic. The Lionesses travelled to the Pankritio Stadium in Crete knowing a victory would put them in a commanding position in the two-legged tie. Hampton, James and Walsh were included from the off, while Lexi Potter was named among the substitutes. England dominated possession throughout and Sarina Wiegman's side thought they had taken the lead in the 19th minute when James collected a pass in midfield and produced an exquisite 30-yard lob. However, following a VAR review, the goal was disallowed for offside. The opener arrived late in the first half, as a move started by Walsh ended with Georgia Stanway converting from inside the penalty area. Maya Le Tissier and Alessia Russo then added to the advantage in the second period. Kallisti Brouksair did pull a goal back for Greece with 13 minutes to play, but England are now heavy favourites to progress to the second round of the play-offs ahead of the second leg at the King Power Stadium next Tuesday. Elsewhere, Scotland's 2-0 away win over the Czech Republic included the welcome return to action for Cuthbert, who hadn't featured since suffering a knee injury while on international duty in June. The Blues captain was brought on as a 63rd-minute substitute, and it was shortly after her introduction that Claire Emslie added to Caroline Weir's opener to put Scotland in control in the first leg of their first-round play-off tie. 💙 Good to see you back, @erincuthbert_ #SWNT | #CZESCO pic.twitter.com/iUsHwZrDup It was also a positive night for Veerle Buurman and Wieke Kaptein, as both started in the Netherlands' dominant 8-0 away victory in the first leg of their World Cup qualifying play-off tie against Hungary. Lineth Beerensteyn and Victoria Pelova netted hat-tricks in the win, during which Kaptein completed an hour while Buurman played the full 90 minutes. Sweden and Nathalie Bjorn also celebrated victory in their play-off first leg in Lithuania. The Blues defender played the opening 45 minutes, but it was in the second period Sweden accelerated, eventually running out 5-0 winners and putting themselves firmly in control of the tie. There was a start for Chelsea goalkeeper Livia Peng, although not a clean sheet, as Switzerland recorded a 7-3 away victory in their World Cup qualifying play-off tie with Israel. Geraldine Reuteler put Switzerland ahead and further goals from Iman Beney, Sydney Schertenleib, a brace from Riola Xhemaili, and own goals from Mia Shvill and Itaf Alkisi ensured a comfortable win. Meanwhile, Giulia Dragoni featured as a second-half substitute as Italy recorded a 2-0 away win in their World Cup qualifying play-off against Belarus. Dragoni was introduced just after the hour with the game goalless, but during her time on the pitch Italy struck twice through Martina Piemonte and Elisa Polli to put themselves in command of their tie. Two Blues went head-to-head during a friendly at the Wildparkstadion as Sjoeke Nusken's Germany faced Ellie Carpenter's Australia. Melissa Kossler'sbrace put Germany in front, but in first-half stoppage time, Carpenter exchanged passes and delivered an excellent near-post cross that Sam Kerr – our joint all-time leading goalscorer – headed home. ...but Sjoeke Nüsken seals the match for Germany, 4-2! 🇩🇪 pic.twitter.com/eDOMbFd499 In the second period, Camilla Kuver added a third for Germany, but Australia were given late hope when Holly McNamara netted in stoppage time. However, that was quickly extinguished as, from a corner, Nuksen collected the ball and powered a finish home to mark her 60th appearance for Germany with a goal and ensure victory. Maika Hamano was also in friendly action, and the Blues forward was on the scoresheet as Japan recorded a 5-1 win over Haiti. Hamano netted her country's second goal of the contest, which came in the 33rd minute, before she was replaced at half time.
news.body_zh: 汉娜·汉普顿、劳伦·詹姆斯和凯拉·沃尔什均首发出场，英格兰队在 2027 年女足世界杯首轮附加赛与希腊队的比赛中以 3-1 领先，而蓝军队长艾琳·库斯伯特则在苏格兰战胜捷克队时重返赛场。母狮队前往克里特岛的潘克里蒂奥体育场，知道胜利将使她们在两回合比赛中占据主导地位。汉普顿、詹姆斯和沃尔什从一开始就被列入名单，而莱克西·波特则被列入替补名单。英格兰队自始至终都掌控着控球权，萨琳娜·维格曼的球队在第 19 分钟以为自己取得了领先，詹姆斯在中场接到传球，打出了一记漂亮的 30 码吊射。不过，经过VAR审查后，进球因越位被判无效。上半场晚些时候，沃尔什发起的进攻最终以乔治亚·斯坦威在禁区内的射门结束，揭幕战到来。玛雅·勒蒂西尔（Maya Le Tissier）和阿莱西亚·鲁索（Alessia Russo）随后在第二节扩大了优势。卡利斯蒂·布鲁克赛尔确实在比赛还剩 13 分钟时为希腊队扳回一球，但英格兰队现在是晋级附加赛第二轮的热门球队，下周二将在王权球场进行第二回合比赛。在其他地方，苏格兰客场 2-0 战胜捷克共和国的比赛中，库斯伯特也迎来了回归，自从 6 月份在国家队比赛中膝盖受伤以来，库斯伯特就没有参加过比赛。这位蓝军队长在第 63 分钟替补上场，就在她上场后不久，克莱尔·埃姆斯利 (Claire Emslie) 为卡罗琳·威尔 (Caroline Weir) 的首开纪录，帮助苏格兰在首轮附加赛第一回合中掌控了局势。 💙 很高兴见到你回来，@erincuthbert_ #SWNT | #CZESCO pic.twitter.com/iUsHwZrDup 这对 Veerle Buurman 和 Wieke Kaptein 来说也是一个积极的夜晚，两人在荷兰队在世界杯预选赛附加赛首回合对阵匈牙利的首回合客场8-0大胜的比赛中首发出场。莱恩斯·贝伦斯泰因 (Lineth Beerenstein) 和维多利亚·佩洛娃 (Victoria Pelova) 在这场胜利中上演帽子戏法，其中卡普坦 (Kaptein) 完成了一个小时的比赛，而布尔曼 (Buurman) 则打满了 90 分钟。瑞典队和纳塔莉·比约恩也在立陶宛举行的附加赛首回合比赛中庆祝了胜利。这位蓝军后卫在开场打了45分钟，但在第二节比赛中瑞典队加速进攻，最终以5-0获胜，牢牢掌控了比赛。切尔西门将彭莉薇 (Livia Peng) 首发出场，尽管未能零失球，瑞士队在世界杯预选赛附加赛中客场以 7-3 战胜以色列。杰拉尔丁·鲁特勒 (Geraldine Reuteler) 帮助瑞士取得领先，伊曼·贝尼 (Iman Beney)、西德尼·舍滕莱布 (Sydney Schertenleib) 的进一步进球、里奥拉·谢麦利 (Riola Xhemaili) 的梅开二度以及米娅·施维尔 (Mia Shvill) 和伊塔夫·阿尔基西 (Itaf Alkisi) 的乌龙球确保了轻松获胜。与此同时，朱利亚·德拉戈尼下半场替补出场，帮助意大利队在世界杯预选赛附加赛中客场2-0战胜白俄罗斯队。德拉格尼在比赛一小时后就被换下，当时比赛没有进球，但在她上场期间，意大利队通过玛蒂娜·皮埃蒙特和埃利萨·波利两次进球，控制了比赛。在Wildparkstadion 举行的一场友谊赛中，两支蓝军展开了正面交锋，绍克·努斯肯率领的德国队对阵埃莉·卡彭特率领的澳大利亚队。梅丽莎·科斯勒 (Melissa Kossler) 的梅开二度让德国队取得领先，但在上半场伤停补时阶段，卡彭特 (Carpenter) 互相传球，并在近门柱附近传中，由我们并列历史最佳射手萨姆·科尔 (Sam Kerr) 头球破门。 ...但 Sjoeke Nüsken 为德国锁定胜局，4-2！ 🇩🇪 pic.twitter.com/eDOMbFd499 在第二节比赛中，卡米拉·库弗为德国队打入第三球，但当霍莉·麦克纳马拉在补时阶段进球时，澳大利亚队终于看到了希望。然而，这种情况很快就被扑灭了，努克森从角球处接球并射门得分，这是她为德国队出场 60 次并攻入一球，确保了胜利。滨野舞香也参加了友谊赛，这位蓝军前锋进球帮助日本队以 5-1 战胜海地队。滨野在第 33 分钟攻入了她的国家队在比赛中的第二个进球，随后她在半场结束时被换下。

news.title: Alonso on Acheampong's 'step forward' and Estevao's importance
news.title_zh: 阿隆索谈 Acheampong 的“进步”和 Estevao 的重要性
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has reiterated that Josh Acheampong and Estevao Willian will play important roles for Chelsea as the season progresses, with the development of our Academy graduate and the Brazilian's influence emphasised. The pair have already featured for Chelsea under Alonso this season and impressed for their respective countries during the international break. Acheampong has become a key player in the England Under-21s side, and helped the Young Lions seal qualification for next year’s UEFA European Under-21 Championship with a game to spare. Our Academy graduate has also made six appearances for the Blues this season, and Alonso feels the 20-year-old defender has shown he is ready to compete at the highest level. ‘Josh has played a few games and is ready to play,’ said our manager ahead of Bournemouth's visit to Stamford Bridge tomorrow. ‘I saw he did well with the Under-21s;  I know he didn’t play the last game but he has done well. ‘He has taken a step forward. He is playing more maturely and more aggressively, and is knowing what it takes to compete in the Premier League. ‘He is on that journey as he has great potential and great qualities. He has played and he will play again.’ There was no competitive action for Estevao during the international break, but he featured in all three of the senior Brazil team’s friendlies and claimed a goal and an assist in the final game: a 4-0 win over India. Still only 19 years old, the winger has time on his side. Alonso is carefully handling the teenager after he missed the end of last season and the summer’s FIFA World Cup due to a hamstring injury, but our manager is certain Estevao’s time will come soon. ‘It’s still early in the season, just a few games since we started. Este is feeling much better from the injury; we have seen with Brazil that he has played more. ‘The context is different when he played with the international team than in the Premier League. We know the demands of the Premier League and we know how important Este can be in some games. He will have his moments and more minutes.’ One player who didn’t travel to join up with his national team was Moises Caicedo, who remained at Cobham to continue working on his return to full fitness following injury. Alonso has confirmed the Ecuadorian has been training well and is available for selection when we get back into Premier League action against Bournemouth, potentially providing a big boost for the Blues with his return to the line-up. ‘For sure, any team would miss a player of his quality, his importance, his weight [to the team] and his dynamic. We have missed him for sure and we are happy that we have him back,’ Xabi added. ‘He feels better and we didn’t want to take any risks against Brentford, for example. I did myself against Brighton and after I said, “Xabi, you did this wrong”. Now he feels much better.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索重申，随着赛季的进行，乔什·阿奇姆蓬和埃斯特沃·威廉将在切尔西发挥重要作用，我们的青训毕业生的发展和巴西人的影响力将得到强调。两人本赛季已经在阿隆索麾下为切尔西队效力，并在国际比赛日期间为各自的国家队留下了深刻的印象。阿奇姆蓬已经成为英格兰U-21队的关键球员，并帮助幼狮队在还剩一场比赛的情况下锁定了明年欧洲U-21锦标赛的参赛资格。我们的青训毕业生本赛季还为蓝军出场六次，阿隆索认为这位 20 岁的后卫已经表明他已经准备好参加最高水平的比赛。 “约什已经踢了几场比赛，并且已经做好了上场的准备，”我们的主教练在伯恩茅斯明天造访斯坦福桥之前说道。 “我看到他在 21 岁以下青年队中表现出色；  我知道他没有参加上一场比赛，但他做得很好。 ‘他向前迈出了一步。他的踢球更加成熟、更具侵略性，并且知道在英超联赛中竞争需要什么。 “他正在踏上这段旅程，因为他拥有巨大的潜力和出色的品质。埃斯特沃在国际比赛日期间没有参加任何比赛，但他参加了巴西成年队的所有三场友谊赛，并在最后一场比赛中攻入进球和助攻：4-0战胜印度。这位边锋还只有 19 岁，他还有时间。由于腿筋受伤，阿隆索错过了上赛季末和今年夏天的国际足联世界杯，阿隆索正在小心地对待这位少年，但我们的主教练确信埃斯特瓦奥的时代很快就会到来。 “现在还处于赛季初期，距离我们开始只有几场比赛。埃斯特因受伤感觉好多了。我们在巴西队看到他踢得更多。 “他在国际队踢球时的环境与在英超联赛中不同。我们了解英超联赛的要求，也知道埃斯特在某些比赛中的重要性。他将会有他的时刻和更多的上场时间。”莫伊塞斯·凯塞多（Moises Caicedo）是一名没有前往国家队参赛的球员，他留在科巴姆继续努力恢复受伤后的完全健康。阿隆索确认厄瓜多尔人训练状况良好，当我们回到英超联赛对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛时，他就可以入选，他的回归可能会给蓝军带来巨大的推动力。 “当然，任何球队都会想念像他这样的球员，他的品质、他的重要性、他对球队的分量以及他的活力。我们肯定很想念他，我们很高兴他回来了，”哈比补充道。 “他感觉好多了，例如，我们不想在对阵布伦特福德的比赛中冒任何风险。我在对阵布莱顿的比赛中做了自己，然后我说：“哈维，你做错了”。现在他感觉好多了。

news.title: FPL 2026/27: Chelsea Gameweek six
news.title_zh: FPL 2026/27：切尔西第六周比赛
news.body_en: Chelsea have teamed up with Fantasy Football Scout to help bring you hints, tips and advice during the 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) season. Scout will be using their expertise to provide advice and gameweek tips which should prove useful in ensuring you win your mini-leagues. Here, we look at which Blues players are the best value-for-money picks, why Morgan Rogers (£7.8m) is Chelsea’s most popular player this week, and who you should captain in Gameweek 6. No Chelsea player has been transferred in by more Fantasy managers than Morgan Rogers (£7.8m) ahead of the Gameweek 6 deadline. Over 200,000 people have moved to bring Chelsea’s summer signing into their team; he now sits in just under 40 per cent of squads and is the most-selected midfielder in the game. Against Brentford in Gameweek 5, no Blues player registered more xGI than Rogers’ 0.4 or had more shots on goal (4). Among Chelsea players, Rogers ranks joint-first for chances created (11) and shots on target (5). This demonstrates his potential for both goals and assists ahead of Saturday’s fixture against Bournemouth. The Chelsea number 17 has notched an attacking return in both his Stamford Bridge appearances so far. With strong form and plenty of transfers in, expect Rogers’ Fantasy price to keep on rising. Wesley Fofana (£5.0m) is the only Blues defender to start every game when available this season and ranks joint-first for defensive contributions among Chelsea players with 47. The Frenchman has picked up four DefCon points and averages 13.56 DefCons per 90, well clear of the 10 required for extra points. Only 0.2 per cent of managers have selected Fofana in Fantasy. In goal, Emi Martinez (£5.0m) continued his record of notching at least one save point in every Gameweek. Since the Argentinian made his debut in Gameweek 2, no goalkeeper has made more saves across the entire league. This increases his Fantasy ceiling as and when the clean sheets start to build up. With Erling Haaland (£15.6m) playing away against Liverpool this week, Bukayo Saka (£9.6m) takes centre stage for Arsenal’s home match-up against Leeds. The Gunners scored nine goals without reply against Daniel Farke’s side last season. Saka has scored three goals in five matches and registered some mightily impressive underlying numbers. No midfielder can better his tally of 4.19 xGI or his six big chances. The Englishman has also taken seven corners and created seven chances. Elsewhere, Morgan Gibbs-White (£8.0m) is an intriguing option against Crystal Palace. The English midfielder has registered three attacking returns in the last four Gameweeks and takes penalties for Nottingham Forest. The Tricky Trees have impressed on the road so far this season and travel to Selhurst Park. The Eagles rank bottom for expected goals conceded (xGC) among all teams. No player has created more big chances (5) so far this season than Gibbs-White, who nearly 100,000 Fantasy managers have bought.
news.body_zh: 切尔西已与 Fantasy Football Scout 合作，帮助您在 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) 赛季期间为您提供提示、技巧和建议。球探将利用他们的专业知识提供建议和比赛周技巧，这对确保您赢得迷你联赛很有用。在这里，我们来看看哪些蓝军球员是性价比最高的球员，为什么摩根·罗杰斯（780万英镑）是本周切尔西最受欢迎的球员，以及你应该在第六场比赛中担任队长。在第六场比赛截止日期之前，没有哪个切尔西球员比摩根·罗杰斯（780万英镑）被更多的梦幻主帅转会。超过 200,000 名员工已将切尔西夏季签约球员带入自己的球队；现在，他在球队中的出场率略低于 40%，并且是比赛中被选中最多的中场球员。在第五场比赛对阵布伦特福德的比赛中，没有任何蓝军球员的 xGI 值比罗杰斯的 0.4 多，或者射门次数也多（4 次）。在切尔西球员中，罗杰斯在创造机会（11）和射正（5）方面并列第一。这表明了他在周六对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛之前进球和助攻的潜力。到目前为止，这位切尔西 17 号球员在斯坦福桥的两场比赛中都取得了进攻上的回报。凭借强劲的状态和大量的转会，预计罗杰斯的幻想队价格将继续上涨。韦斯利·福法纳（500万英镑）是本赛季唯一一位在每场比赛中首发的蓝军后卫，他在防守贡献方面以 47 分在切尔西球员中并列第一。这位法国人获得了 4 分，平均每 90 场防守得分为 13.56 分，远远超过了额外得分所需的 10 分。只有 0.2% 的主帅选择了 Fantasy 中的 Fofana。在进球方面，埃米·马丁内斯（Emi Martinez，500万英镑）延续了他在每个比赛周至少获得一个保存点的记录。自从阿根廷人在第二场比赛中首次亮相以来，整个联赛中没有门将做出更多扑救。当零失球开始增多时，这会增加他的幻想上限。埃尔林·哈兰德（1560万英镑）本周客场对阵利物浦，布卡约·萨卡（960万英镑）在阿森纳主场对阵利兹联的比赛中成为焦点。上赛季，枪手在对阵丹尼尔·法克的球队时打进了九个进球，但没有取得任何进球。萨卡在五场比赛中打进了三个进球，并取得了一些令人印象深刻的基本数据。没有任何中场球员能比他 4.19 xGI 的数据或他的 6 次绝佳机会更好。英国人还开出了七个角球并创造了七次机会。在其他地方，摩根·吉布斯-怀特（800万英镑）是对阵水晶宫的一个有趣的选择。这位英格兰中场球员在过去四个星期的比赛中完成了三次进攻，并为诺丁汉森林队主罚点球。棘手的树在本赛季迄今为止的道路上给人留下了深刻的印象，并前往塞尔赫斯特公园。老鹰队的预期失球数 (xGC) 在所有球队中排名垫底。本赛季迄今为止，没有哪位球员比吉布斯-怀特创造了更多的绝佳机会（5次），他已经被近10万幻想队主教练买下。

news.title: Alonso ready for ‘intense’ and ‘demanding’ Bournemouth challenge
news.title_zh: 阿隆索已准备好迎接“激烈”和“苛刻”的伯恩茅斯挑战
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso believes the Blues have put our extra time at the training ground to good use during the international break to prepare for the difficult challenge he knows we will face when Bournemouth come to Stamford Bridge. After a three-week break due to the new international calendar introduced for 2026/27, the Premier League returns this weekend with Chelsea hosting Bournemouth in a 3pm kick-off on Saturday. The Cherries are winless in the league this season, but their only defeats have come against Manchester City and Liverpool. Bournemouth’s performances have also arguably merited more than the three points they have won, and they showed their threat with a 2-1 victory away at Real Sociedad in their opening UEFA Europa League fixture. Our manager certainly won’t be underestimating Marco Rose’s side and has been using the time off from matches during the international break to prepare. ‘It will be a tough test,’ said Alonso, when asked for his opinion on our next opponents in his pre-match press conference on Friday. ‘It will be so intense, a high-tempo game and very demanding. They have a clear idea of what they do with Marco and previously with Andoni [Iraola]. ‘The core of the team is the same and every time you have to play Bournemouth it’s tough. But we play at home, and we want and need a win. So we are getting ready for tomorrow. ‘We’ve had time for everything, to analyse what we have done in the games and what is coming. We have been working with some players, recovering some players, we’ve used the time properly for that, and getting ready for Bournemouth tomorrow.’ The Blues are looking to get back to winning ways after going into the international break off a defeat at Brentford as the momentum from our strong start to the season took a hit. However, Alonso underlined that it is still a work in progress at this early stage in his tenure, with the most important thing being that the team continues to learn and improve from every game. ‘It’s going to take time. How long? We’ll keep checking,’ Alonso added. ‘We need to keep improving, keep on learning, be in the process to be competitive, be good, learn how to read the moments and adapt to situations. ‘It’s part of the process and the feeling is that from each game we are learning things, but we need to make sure we don’t make the same mistakes again, knowing that each game is tough.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索相信蓝军在国际比赛日期间充分利用了在训练场上的额外时间，为伯恩茅斯来到斯坦福桥时我们将面临的艰难挑战做好准备。由于 2026/27 年新国际赛程的引入，英超联赛在休息三周后，将于本周末回归，切尔西将在周六下午 3 点主场迎战伯恩茅斯。樱桃队本赛季在联赛中未尝胜绩，但唯一的失利是对阵曼城和利物浦。伯恩茅斯的表现也可以说比他们赢得的三分更有价值，他们在欧联杯首场比赛中客场 2-1 战胜皇家社会队，展现了自己的威胁。我们的主教练当然不会低估马科·罗斯的球队，他一直在利用国际比赛日期间的休息时间进行准备。 “这将是一次严峻的考验，”阿隆索在周五的赛前新闻发布会上被问及对我们下一个对手的看法时说道。 “这将是一场非常激烈的比赛，节奏很快，要求很高。他们清楚地知道他们对 Marco 以及之前对 Andoni [Iraola] 所做的事情。 “球队的核心是一样的，每次对阵伯恩茅斯都会很艰难。但我们是在主场比赛，我们想要并且需要一场胜利。所以我们正在为明天做好准备。 “我们有时间处理所有事情，分析我们在比赛中所做的事情以及即将发生的事情。我们一直在与一些球员合作，恢复一些球员，我们已经适当地利用了这段时间，并为明天对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛做好准备。”蓝军在国际比赛中输给布伦特福德后，希望能重新回到胜利的轨道上，因为我们本赛季强劲开局的势头受到了打击。然而，阿隆索强调，在他任职的早期阶段，这仍然是一项正在进行的工作，最重要的是球队继续从每场比赛中学习和提高。 ‘这需要时间。多长时间？我们会继续检查，”阿隆索补充道。 “我们需要不断进步，不断学习，在这个过程中保持竞争力，变得优秀，学习如何把握时机并适应情况。 “这是这个过程的一部分，感觉是我们从每场比赛中都在学习东西，但我们需要确保我们不会再犯同样的错误，因为我们知道每场比赛都很艰难。”

news.title: Xabi Alonso confirms Chelsea team news for Bournemouth
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索确认了切尔西队为伯恩茅斯效力的消息
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso says Moises Caicedo is 'ready to go' against Bournemouth, and there are also positive updates on the fitness of Reece James, Marco Palestra, Cole Palmer and Joao Pedro. Following the extended international break, which Alonso described as positive for the Blues but 'probably too long', we return to action tomorrow afternoon as Bournemouth visit Stamford Bridge in the Premier League. The three-week gap between fixtures gave Alonso and his coaching and medical staff quality time to work with several players at Cobham, and five members of his squad have recovered from issues that kept them sidelined in the early weeks of the season or out of representing their countries. One of those is Caicedo. The Ecuadorian midfielder has featured only once this term – a curtailed substitute appearance against Brighton and Hove Albion in August – due to injury, but returned to full training during the break and is available for selection against Bournemouth. ‘Yes, he is ready to go,' Alonso replied when asked about Caicedo's fitness. 'We have used the time with Moi to get him back fit. He has been training well and he is okay to go.’ Alonso also confirmed that Marco Palestra, who has yet to make his competitive debut for the Blues due to an injury sustained in the final week of pre-season, is in contention to feature against the Cherries. There was also good news on the fitness of James, Palmer and Joao Pedro, each of whom had to withdraw from representing England and Brazil, respectively, due to fitness concerns. James and Joao Pedro missed our last outing before the international break, away to Brentford, while Alonso admits Palmer was struggling against the Bees. However, the trio have all trained ahead of Bournemouth's visit and could feature. ‘They have all been able to train, some of them earlier than others – and Marco Palestra as well. That was the plan. 'We knew that going into Brentford we had some players struggling but they have trained well and are ready to go.’ On Palmer, Alonso added: 'He has trained the last week and has felt better. We didn’t want to rush because we had the time. What is most important for Cole is to be fully fit and that he enjoys his game and is feeling okay. 'In the Brentford game, we could see he was struggling and for the next part [of the season] we have a good feeling for him and that he is feeling better.’ The only disappointing news to come from Alonso's pre-match press conference was the confirmation that Jamie Gittens, who suffered an ankle injury while representing England Under-21s during the international break, will be ruled out for the foreseeable future. Alonso said: ‘He is not going to be fit for tomorrow; that is the bad news from the international break. He picked up an injury on his ankle and is going to be out for a few weeks.’ There’s still time to secure your seat and watch the Saturday 3pm action live from the best seats in the house with Club Chelsea. Final VIP tickets available – book now.
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索表示莫伊塞斯·凯塞多已经“准备好”对阵伯恩茅斯，里斯·詹姆斯、马可·帕莱斯特拉、科尔·帕尔默和若昂·佩德罗的健康状况也有积极的进展。在延长的国际比赛日之后，阿隆索称这对蓝军来说是积极的，但“可能太长了”，明天下午我们将重返赛场，伯恩茅斯将在英超联赛中客场挑战斯坦福桥。两场比赛之间的三周间隔让阿隆索和他的教练和医务人员有充足的时间在科巴姆与几名球员一起工作，他的球队中的五名成员已经从赛季初几周缺席或无法代表国家队参赛的问题中恢复过来。凯塞多就是其中之一。由于受伤，这位厄瓜多尔中场本赛季只出场过一次——8月份对阵布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩的比赛中替补出场，但在中场休息期间恢复了全面训练，并且可以在对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中入选。 “是的，他已经准备好了，”当被问及凯塞多的健康状况时，阿隆索回答道。 “我们利用与莫伊在一起的时间让他恢复健康。他训练得很好，可以离开。阿隆索还证实，由于季前赛最后一周受伤，尚未为蓝军上演正式比赛首秀的马尔科·帕莱斯特拉将有机会在对阵樱桃队的比赛中出场。詹姆斯、帕尔默和若奥·佩德罗的健康状况也有好消息，他们都因健康问题而分别退出了英格兰队和巴西队的比赛。詹姆斯和若昂·佩德罗错过了国际比赛日之前客场对阵布伦特福德的最后一场比赛，而阿隆索承认帕尔默在对阵蜜蜂队的比赛中表现不佳。然而，这三人都在伯恩茅斯来访之前接受了训练，并且可以出场。 “他们都能够接受训练，其中一些人比其他人更早——马可·帕莱斯特拉也是如此。这就是计划。 “我们知道进入布伦特福德时，我们有一些球员表现不佳，但他们训练得很好，已经做好了上场的准备。”关于帕尔默，阿隆索补充道：“他上周进行了训练，感觉好多了。”我们不想着急，因为我们有时间。对于科尔来说，最重要的是保持完全健康，并且他享受比赛并且感觉良好。 “在布伦特福德的比赛中，我们可以看到他很挣扎，在本赛季的下一部分，我们对他有很好的感觉，而且他感觉好多了。”阿隆索赛前新闻发布会上唯一令人失望的消息是确认杰米·吉滕斯在国际比赛日代表英格兰 21 岁以下国家队时脚踝受伤，将在可预见的未来缺席比赛。阿隆索说：“他不会适合明天的比赛；这是国际比赛日带来的坏消息。 ”最终 VIP 门票现已发售——立即预订。

news.title: Premier League ticket news: Leeds at home
news.title_zh: 英超联赛门票新闻：利兹联主场
news.body_en: Ticket selling details have been announced for next month's home game. Chelsea host Leeds United for a Premier League contest at Stamford Bridge on Saturday 21 November with kick-off at 3pm. Home tickets for members for men’s team matches are allocated through a new application process. For each home match, eligible members have a designated application window during which they can apply for tickets. Applications can be made individually or as a group, provided all members of the group are eligible to apply during that window. Tickets will be allocated one per person with a maximum of four per application. Ticket application window opens – Monday 12 October 12pm Ticket application window closes – Thursday 15 October 12pm The ticket application window will be open for True Blue+, True Blue, CFC Blue and Junior Blue members. As part of the verification process, a pre-authorisation charge £0.01 will be applied to validate your payment card. No money will be taken at this stage, and the hold will be removed by your provider. Tickets for this match are priced at Category A. Please click here for match ticket prices Tickets will appear on the Chelsea Official App prior to the event. Eligible members can submit their application through the official ticketing portal at any time during the window, supporters must ensure they are logged in to successfully apply. Applying earlier does not increase the likelihood of success, giving supporters greater flexibility to apply at a time that suits them. As part of the new ticket sales process, members who are eligible for concession-rate tickets are automatically assigned their price class. To ensure you are receiving the correct ticket, please take the time to check the date of birth on your account is accurate. You will only be allocated tickets in your selected areas unless you choose to be considered for other available options. If you only wish to be entered for tickets in one area of the stadium, please leave the second option blank. Please read the ticket application information carefully before submitting your application. Successful and unsuccessful applications will be notified by email within four working days of the ticket application window closing date. Successful applications will be charged to their payment card approximately at this time. Supporters are not able to use account credit for ticket application window purchases. All persons under the age of 16 will be required to attend with and sit next to, a person aged 18 years of age or over. Members and season ticket holders can purchase Westview tickets for Premier League home games via the Chelsea FC Official Ticketing Portal. A maximum of four tickets can be bought per person, and only the ticket purchaser is required to be a member or season ticket holder. You are not required to be a member or season ticket holder to purchase non-Westview Club Chelsea packages. Club Chelsea tickets are non-refundable unless the match is cancelled, postponed, or moved more than 48 hours either side of the scheduled fixture date. All Club Chelsea ticket purchases are subject to Club Chelsea terms and conditions. For any further Westview enquiries, please email clubchelsea@chelseafc.com. Loyalty points will now only be awarded for attendance at men’s first-team home matches and no longer accrued for purchasing tickets. Points will be added to eligible accounts following each game, provided the ticket has been scanned at the turnstile. This means that supporters purchasing tickets on the ticket exchange, or receiving tickets via ticket forwarding, will now receive loyalty points for attending matches. Supporters will receive three loyalty points for attending this match. Points will be applied after the fixture has been played. Members can still purchase general admission tickets if available in line with the General Admission Policy. Supporters who require accessible tickets can apply through the accessible ticket application window. Timings are below: Accessible ticket application window opens - Monday 12 October 12pm Accessible ticket application window closes – Thursday 15 October 12pm Supporters, if they are able to do so, can call our Access Team on 0371 811 2012 or 0044 207 915 1950 (international callers) for any questions or if they need further information. Personal assistant tickets can be submitted during this ticket application window. Supporters can apply for car parking by clicking here from Thursday 22 October 2026. You are required to display your Blue Badge while parked at Stamford Bridge. In addition to season ticket holders, True Blue+, True Blue and CFC Blue members now have the option to list tickets on the ticket exchange if they are unable to attend a home match. Supporters can access the ticket exchange through the official ticketing portal. The sales information on the buy tickets pagewill be updated once the ticket exchange is open. The ticket exchange will close three hours before kick-off, unless stated otherwise. Those unsuccessful in the ticket application window will have a ticket exchange priority period. These supporters will be notified via email that the priority window is open. A further announcement will be made on the buy tickets page to confirm when the ticket exchange is open to all members. The all on-sale dates page available by clicking here will also be updated. Once open, season ticket holders and members can send and receive tickets up until three hours before kick-off. Please note that those who have forwarded their ticket will not be able to list their ticket on the ticket exchange. Click for ticket forwarding FAQs Requests to refund tickets purchased from the general admission on-sale period must reach the ticket office no later than 3pm on Thursday 12 November (seven working days before the fixture). news.title: Sport’s global leaders converge on Chelsea FC

news.body_en: No midweek match but Stamford Bridge has still been busy. The venue spaces at our stadium have been the location for Leaders Week London, a business summit attended by over 3,000 senior executives from every facet of sport. With the Great Hall in the West Stand transformed as the principal space, and hospitality suites plus settings such as Frankie’s and the Stamford Bridge Hotel utilised for a mix of talks, meetings, presentations plus places to network and socialise, it was our ability to provide a campus-style experience in a well-connected central London location that was key to Leaders Week reimagining the well-established event here. Indeed, Chelsea Football Club first staged a Leaders conference in 2008 and continued to do so at the stadium over the following decade. The relocation back to the Bridge for 2026 and the start of this new era for Leaders Week London heralds a multi-year agreement for the flagship event to continue to be held in SW6. This year, there were speakers from across the sports industry: from teams, leagues and associations; broadcasters, tech and service providers; and investment companies, agencies and sponsor brands. Consumer desires, cross-industry collaborations and AI were just some of the themes covered. Click to learn more about Events at Stamford Bridge

news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club is pleased to confirm that Academy midfielder Jayden Malundama has signed his first professional contract with the Blues. Malundama joined Chelsea as an Under-8 and has progressed through the youth ranks at Cobham. The defensive midfielder is a confident dribbler who uses his close control to progress play. news.title: Levi Colwill on his ‘new chapter’ and how the tough times help
news.title_zh: 利瓦伊·科尔威尔谈他的“新篇章”以及艰难时期如何提供帮助
news.body_en: Levi Colwill discusses a new chapter in his Chelsea career as part of an exclusive interview in the matchday programme for Saturday’s Premier League fixture against Bournemouth. The homegrown Blues defender missed much of last season through injury and now has a fresh mentality under Xabi Alonso this season. ‘This is a new chapter in my life and I’m feeling good,’ he explains. ‘I’m a different person, I’ve learned so much, but I feel like it’s for the better, and I’m ready to push on. ‘I’ve seen ups, downs, a big injury. I’ve probably been through more than an average player would normally go through in his career already. But it’s all helped me in different ways, made me more experienced and a more mature head than probably most 23-year-olds out there.’ Colwill also talks about the intricacies of playing in a back three, which is fitting in a programme where our Greatest Games feature harks back to the 2016/17 title-winning campaign, when a 3-0 win over Bournemouth made up part of a 13-game winning run after we switched to a 3-4-3 system at the beginning of autumn. Our latest Legacy feature also takes us back to a title-winning recipe, as we look at the impact of Ted Drake on the club, how he took Chelsea from mid-table mediocrity to our first league championship, before struggling to repeat the trick with a young side known as Drake’s Ducklings. Elsewhere, inspired by Moises Caicedo’s outrageous Goal of the Season winner against Bournemouth in May 2024, we’ve picked out our Five Long-Range Stunners for your enjoyment. We also have all the info you need ahead of this weekend’s match, plus columns from Xabi Alonso, Reece James, Sonia Bompastor and our Academy coaches. We have the latest news, stats and facts, plus your messages. Don’t forget to pick up your copy from the programme sellers around Stamford Bridge, or order online from our official publications partner, Reach Sport.
news.body_zh: 列维·科尔威尔在周六英超联赛对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛日节目中接受独家采访，讨论了他切尔西职业生涯的新篇章。这位本土蓝军后卫因伤缺席了上赛季的大部分比赛，本赛季在哈维·阿隆索的带领下，他的心态焕然一新。 “这是我人生的新篇章，我感觉很好，”他解释道。 “我是一个不同的人，我学到了很多东西，但我觉得一切都会变得更好，我已经准备好继续前进。 “我经历过起起落落，也经历过严重的伤病。我所经历的事情可能比普通球员在职业生涯中通常经历的事情还要多。但这一切都以不同的方式帮助了我，让我比大多数 23 岁的年轻人更有经验，头脑更成熟。”科尔威尔还谈到了三后卫的复杂性，这很适合我们的“最伟大的比赛”专题回顾 2016/17 夺冠赛季的节目，当时 3-0 战胜伯恩茅斯，成为我们改用后场后 13 场连胜的一部分。初秋实行3-4-3制。我们最新的《遗产》专题也让我们回到了夺冠的秘诀，我们看看特德·德雷克对俱乐部的影响，他如何带领切尔西从中游平庸到我们的第一个联赛冠军，然后努力与德雷克小鸭队的年轻球队重复这一伎俩。在其他地方，受到莫伊塞斯·凯塞多 2024 年 5 月对阵伯恩茅斯的令人震惊的赛季最佳进球的启发，我们挑选了五位远射绝妙球员供您欣赏。我们还提供了本周末比赛前您需要的所有信息，以及 Xabi Alonso、Reece James、Sonia Bompastor 和我们学院教练的专栏。我们有最新的新闻、统计数据和事实，以及您的消息。不要忘记从斯坦福桥周边的节目销售商处获取您的副本，或从我们的官方出版物合作伙伴 Reach Sport 在线订购。

news.body_en: The Premier League returns after a three-week absence when Chelsea host Bournemouth at Stamford Bridge on Saturday afternoon, and we here take a look at all the vital facts and figures ahead of this weekend's fixture. Chelsea head into the sixth round of matches of this Premier League season in tenth place in the table, eight points behind leaders Manchester City. Opponents Bournemouth are 17th with three points from three draws. Chelsea are unbeaten in our past nine Premier League games against Bournemouth (four wins, five draws), with each of the last three ending level. The run began with a 2-2 draw in February 2020. The Cherries last beat us earlier that same season, when Dan Gosling scored a late winner at Stamford Bridge. Last season’s corresponding fixture at the end of December finished 2-2, with our goals coming from Cole Palmer with a penalty and Enzo Fernandez. The sides first met at Stamford Bridge in March 1989, when Chelsea won 2-0 through Gordon Durie's goal and a Graham Roberts penalty. Following four consecutive home Premier League defeats between March and May, Chelsea are now unbeaten in three home matches in the competition (two wins, one draw). Chelsea are the tenth team in Premier League history to both score and concede double figures in their first five matches of the season (10-12). Against Brentford, 35-year-old Danny Welbeck and 36-year-old Jordan Henderson were the oldest English players to start a Premier League game for Chelsea since a 36-year-old John Terry in May 2017 against Sunderland. Together with Emiliano Martinez, they make up three three of our top ten oldest Premier League debutants. In the same game, Mahdi Nicoll-Jazuli became the first player born in 2010 to play in the Premier League, while he was also the first 16-year-old to play for Chelsea in the competition. He is the ninth 16-year-old to play for Chelsea and fifth-youngest (16 years, 255 days), nine days after Reggie Watson became our fourth-youngest player, against Leeds United in the Carabao Cup. Chelsea’s first two Premier League home games of 2026/27 produced 11 goals (six scored, five conceded), our highest total across the opening two home league matches since 1997/98 (also 11). According to Premier League figures, Pedro Neto has recorded Chelsea’s highest speed this season, reaching 35.26 km/h against Brighton on 30 August. That ranks sixth-fastest in the division, while Liverpool’s Bradley Barcola leads overall at 35.93 km/h. Having played 101 games, Cole Palmer is one away from scoring 50 goals in the Premier League for the club. In our last game at Brentford, Josh Acheampong made his 50th appearance for Chelsea and Wesley Fofana started his 50th Premier League game for the club. news.title: Analysis: How Bompastor's resilient Blues are working for each other
news.title_zh: 分析：邦帕斯特的坚韧蓝军如何为彼此效力
news.body_en: There’s change in the air at Chelsea. Currently on a run of nine hours without conceding a goal, the players have a new level of resilience and are showing they are tougher than ever. Here's how... Only three goals have been scored against us in our opening nine matches of the campaign. Three of those nine games have been against Manchester United, Arsenal and eight-time Women’s Champions League winners Lyon. Two more were a high-stakes knockout clash against Real Sociedad for a place in this season’s Champions League. Bompastor’s words reinforce the idea of a shift in focus this season. After the 1-0 win against Arsenal at Stamford Bridge, she said: 'We were also really strong in terms of the mental aspect, but also physical aspects: winning the duels and defending the box. ‘To not concede against an Arsenal side who are a strong team with great talent in the attacking line, midfield, the full-backs...everywhere, it's a great result and performance.' And it shows up in our players’ post-match interviews, too. ‘We were ready for the physical fight,’ said Alyssa Thompson after a hard-earned 1-0 win over Champions League newbies Austria Vienna. ‘I feel great with the team that we have, and we know we can put up a fight and play in these physical games.' After the victory over Arsenal, Keira Walsh explained, ‘We can control the ball, and we are also a lot more difficult to beat. We're really tight defending our box now. We know we can play with the ball, but now we can outwork and outfight teams. We do it as a team rather than individuals, and this year, we know we've got each other's backs. We're working for each other.’ The language in these interviews says it all: fighting, working, togetherness, strength. But it’s not just talk. The hard work is showing up in the physical data in key metrics. They may only look like small improvements to the naked eye, but when the margins between the top teams are so fine, they can be the difference between winning and losing. Those numbers represent a mountain of hard work from the team so far this season, and the success of this approach hangs upon every player buying into it. Let's take a look at last season. Our run of six consecutive Women's Super League titles ended with a third-place finish in the league. Of course, our team was still stacked with talent, but that alone would no longer be enough. Opposition sides had figured out they could earn results by playing the underdog role: working to win every single ball. Perhaps they couldn't beat us with talent, but they just might be able to earn something with intensity. Our 1-1 draw with Liverpool last November shows this pattern. The home side made almost double the number of tackles, as well as more interceptions and duels won. They got their reward with a point, one of only 17 they earned after 22 games in 2025/26. It wasn't just the teams lower down the table, either. A trip to the Etihad Stadium in February saw us lose 5-1 to title rivals Manchester City. It's not a game that Blues supporters will want to revisit, but the stats tell the story. It wasn't just about the goals. The home side won more duels and significantly more tackles to earn their scoring opportunities. In the old Champions League group stage format, we could've faced Lyon at home and away, accounting for a third of the points on offer over six matches. This season, we took on our high-level opponents as one of six matches in the new league phase of the competition. That means a point is likely enough, should we win our other games. The timing of the fixture was difficult. Placed in the middle of a four-game run in the space of 11 days, the trip to France also came just three days after our 1-0 win over Arsenal at Stamford Bridge. Our players looked exhausted at the final whistle after that victory in SW6, so it was tough to imagine they'd be able to put in a similar shift against Lyon. But that's exactly what we did, and the table below illustrates how we matched them in every physical metric on their turf on the back of the performance against Arsenal. In comparison, the French champions were playing at home and had no league game to contend with the weekend before. Their previous outing was an 8-0 win against Servette in the Champions League on 23 September - they therefore faced us after a full week's rest. Not only did we fight for our point, but we also recovered quickly as we returned to domestic action on Sunday. We took on a West Ham side determined to stop us, putting all 11 players behind the ball. The result? A 3-0 win. You can read how we did here. We don't know what will transpire results-wise after the international break. But Chelsea supporters can rest easy knowing this team will be giving it their all in every match to come.
news.body_zh: 切尔西的空气发生了变化。目前，球员们已连续九小时不失一球，他们的韧性达到了新的水平，并显示出他们比以往任何时候都更加坚强。原因如下...在本赛季的前九场比赛中，我们只攻入了三个进球。这九场比赛中有三场对阵曼联、阿森纳和八届女足欧冠冠军里昂。另外两场是与皇家社会争夺本赛季欧冠席位的高风险淘汰赛。邦帕斯特的话强化了本赛季焦点转移的想法。在斯坦福桥1-0战胜阿森纳后，她说：“我们在精神方面也非常强大，而且在身体方面也非常强大：赢得对决和防守禁区。” “在对阵阿森纳的比赛中不丢球，他们是一支强大的球队，在进攻线、中场、边后卫......各个方面都拥有出色的天赋，这都是出色的结果和表现。”这也出现在我们球员的赛后采访中。 “我们已经做好了身体对抗的准备，”艾丽莎·汤普森在来之不易的1-0战胜欧冠新秀奥地利维也纳后说道。 “我对我们的球队感觉很好，我们知道我们可以在这些体育比赛中奋力拼搏。”战胜阿森纳后，凯拉·沃尔什解释道：“我们可以控制球，而且我们也更难被击败。”我们现在非常严密地防守我们的禁区。我们知道我们可以控球，但现在我们可以超越球队并战胜球队。我们作为一个团队而不是个人来做到这一点，今年，我们知道我们互相支持。我们为彼此而努力。”这些采访中的语言说明了一切：战斗、工作、团结、力量。但这不仅仅是说说而已。艰苦的工作体现在关键指标的物理数据中。肉眼看来，这些进步可能只是很小的进步，但当顶级球队之间的差距如此之大时，它们就可能决定输赢。这些数字代表了球队本赛季迄今为止付出的巨大努力，这种方法的成功取决于每个球员的认同。我们来看看上赛季的情况。我们以联赛第三名结束了女子超级联赛六连冠。当然，我们的团队仍然人才济济，但仅凭这一点还不够。反对派已经意识到他们可以通过扮演失败者的角色来获得成果：努力赢得每一个球。也许他们无法凭借天赋击败我们，但他们也许能够凭借强度赢得一些东西。去年11月我们1-1战平利物浦的比赛就证明了这一点。主队的拦截次数几乎翻了一番，拦截次数和对抗获胜次数也增加了。他们获得了 1 分的奖励，这是他们在 2025/26 赛季 22 场比赛后仅获得的 17 分之一。不仅仅是排名靠后的球队。二月份做客阿提哈德球场时，我们以 5-1 输给了争冠对手曼城。这不是一场蓝军支持者想要重温的比赛，但统计数据已经说明了一切。这不仅仅是目标的问题。主队赢得了更多的对抗和更多的铲断来赢得得分机会。在旧的欧冠小组赛赛制中，我们可以在主客场对阵里昂，在六场比赛中占据三分之一的积分。本赛季，我们与高水平的对手进行了新一轮联赛的六场比赛之一。这意味着如果我们赢得其他比赛，一分就足够了。比赛的时间安排很困难。法国之行正值 11 天的四场比赛中间，三天前我们在斯坦福桥 1-0 战胜阿森纳。在SW6的胜利之后，我们的球员在终场哨声响起时显得精疲力尽，所以很难想象他们能够在对阵里昂的比赛中做出类似的转变。但这正是我们所做的，下表说明了在对阵阿森纳的比赛中，我们如何在他们的地盘上匹配他们的每一项身体指标。相比之下，法甲冠军球队在主场比赛，上周末没有联赛可打。他们的上一场比赛是9月23日在冠军联赛中以8-0战胜塞尔维特——因此他们在休息了一整周后面对我们。我们不仅为自己的观点而战，而且在周日回到国内比赛时我们也很快恢复过来。 我们对阵的是西汉姆联队，他们决心阻止我们，将所有 11 名球员都放在球后。结果呢？ 3-0获胜。您可以在这里阅读我们的做法。我们不知道国际比赛日之后会发生什么结果。但切尔西的支持者可以放心，因为他们知道这支球队将在接下来的每场比赛中全力以赴。

news.title: Pep Chavarria: It’s been an incredible start
news.title_zh: 佩普·查瓦里亚：这是一个令人难以置信的开始
news.body_en: Pep Chavarria reflects on his first few weeks at Chelsea in this exclusive interview, explaining what it’s like working under Xabi Alonso and playing in the Premier League. There is something fitting about Pep Chavarria finding himself at Chelsea. The 28-year-old was born in Figueres, the Catalan town which was also the birthplace of surrealist artist Salvador Dali, and the journey that has taken him from his hometown club in the fourth tier of Spanish football to Stamford Bridge certainly has something surreal about it. Chavarria did not take the conventional route to the top. He made his senior debut with semi-professional outfit Figueres at 18, worked his way through Spain's football pyramid, and did not play his first La Liga game until he was 24. From there, he spent four seasons with Rayo Vallecano, making 125 appearances and establishing himself as a dynamic, attack-minded full-back. It earned him the biggest move of his career, to Chelsea this summer. Now, having made his Blues debut in August and begun to settle into life in England, Pep is determined to make the most of the opportunity. 'It’s been incredible,' he says when we ask about his first few weeks at Chelsea. 'To arrive at this club, this amazing club, and the welcome from the team-mates was incredible. I'm very happy with it all, with the staff, they bring me a lot of love. 'We have top players who are very competitive and they have a strong mentality. I love this because I am learning. It's a pleasure to play with these types of players because when you play with the best, you can improve.' Moving to a new country can be daunting, but Chavarria has quickly found people around him to help with the transition. One of them is Moises Caicedo, who has taken on an important role as team-mate and teacher as Pep gets to grips with life in England. 'Moi stays with me always, and he is now teaching me English because I need to learn,' Chavarria explains, in his already excellent English. He is taking weekly lessons and is determined to be fluent by the end of the season. Away from Cobham, Chavarria has also begun exploring his new surroundings with family and friends, ticking off some of London's most famous landmarks. 'The first days I was busy with my family and friends. For example, we went to Buckingham Palace, Big Ben, the London Eye. It's an amazing city.' For now, though, home is a short distance from Cobham, allowing him to enjoy a balance between the buzz of London and the quieter surroundings of the Surrey countryside. That proximity to the training ground is perhaps fitting for a player who has built his career on hard work, patience and a relentless desire to improve. If Chavarria's route to Chelsea has been unusual, his playing style appears ideally suited to the challenges the Premier League throws up. He has quickly discovered that the intensity of English football suits him. 'I think that the Premier League now is the best league in the world,' he says. 'It has intensity, a lot of quality, and the players are top. I think for me it's the best league that I can play in, because I'm a player that has a lot of energy, and I love going box-to-box and working for the team. 'In La Liga it's more structured, more tactical,' Chavarria adds. 'And here, players have more quality and are more physical. ‘It’s more difficult here because all teams have very good players. The last team in the table can win against the first. Because you play against top players, you need to be at your best level, because here, if you don't stay focused, in one second you can lose the game. You need to be very concentrated all the time.' Another familiar element marks Pep's journey at Chelsea. Like Chavarria, Xabi Alonso's senior career began away from the top level of Spanish football, with the future World Cup and European Championship winner starting in the country's second tier with Real Sociedad B, before establishing himself among the game's elite. Now, the pair are working together at Chelsea, with Alonso looking to harness the qualities that helped Chavarria make his way to Stamford Bridge. 'Xabi is one of the best coaches in the world right now,' says Pep. 'I am learning a lot and I know that he wants to help me. Now I am learning and my adaptation is very good. I think that I can do more and I can improve. 'He wants me to attack and defend with a lot of energy. And we have a lot of solutions. I think that we have a team that is very complete.' For a player who grew up dreaming of reaching the highest level, pulling on the Chelsea shirt at Stamford Bridge has inevitably been a special experience. Pep made his first appearance for us away at Fulham before starting the Carabao Cup victory over Luton Town, where he experienced the unique atmosphere inside the Bridge. 'The stadium is incredible,' he says. 'I saw a lot of matches on TV when I was a kid. I remember that and now I say: "Wow, I'm here". You really feel the energy and the atmosphere. 'The fans are incredible and I am very happy because I see them all and I say: "Wow". The shirt, the stadium, all is incredible, and it's so nice. There is an understandable sense of pride in how far Chavarria has come. He has played at every level of the Spanish football pyramid, earned his opportunity in La Liga with Rayo and helped the club reach a European final before making the leap to Chelsea. His career has been built on grit and persistence, rising through the ranks rather than coming through an academy, as is so often the case these days. All of that has helped him grow in character and stature and landed him at the home of the world champions. Now he is determined to ensure the story keeps moving upward. 'I want to win trophies. This is my goal,' he says. 'And I would like to qualify for the Champions League. 'Chelsea is one of the best clubs in the world and always needs to win one trophy per year and play in the Champions League.' He also has a personal target that has long been beyond his reach, but is now firmly within sight. 'First of all, win a trophy, and then go with the national team,’ he says, before adding in a sign of his team ethic and maturity: ‘But for me, the most important is the club.' For a player who had to climb every step of Spanish football to get here, a place in the Spain squad would represent another remarkable milestone. But Pep knows that the route to that next dream begins with what he does in blue. 'I think that we will bring victories and the fans will be happy - happy to win some trophies.' From Figueres to Olot, Zaragoza and Rayo Vallecano, Chavarria has already proved that patience, determination and hard work can take him a long way. Now, in the surreal setting of Stamford Bridge, the latest chapter of that journey is only just beginning.
news.body_zh: 佩普·查瓦里亚在这次独家采访中回顾了他在切尔西的头几周，解释了在哈维·阿隆索手下工作并在英超踢球的感觉。佩普·查瓦里亚在切尔西找到自己的位置有些合适。这位28岁的球员出生在加泰罗尼亚小镇菲格拉斯，这里也是超现实主义艺术家萨尔瓦多·达利的出生地，他从家乡的西班牙第四级别足球俱乐部来到斯坦福桥的旅程无疑带有一些超现实的色彩。查瓦里亚并没有走传统的登顶路线。 18 岁时，他在半职业球队菲格雷斯首次亮相成年队，在西班牙足球金字塔中一路摸爬滚打，直到 24 岁才首次参加西甲比赛。从那时起，他在巴列卡诺效力了四个赛季，出场 125 次，确立了自己作为一名充满活力、具有攻击性的边后卫的地位。这为他赢得了职业生涯中最大的转会，今年夏天转会到切尔西。现在，佩普在八月份完成了他的蓝军首秀并开始适应英格兰的生活，他决心充分利用这个机会。当我们问及他在切尔西的头几周的情况时，他说道：“这真是令人难以置信。” “来到这个俱乐部，这个了不起的俱乐部，队友们的欢迎令人难以置信。我对这一切感到非常满意，对工作人员来说，他们给了我很多爱。 “我们拥有非常有竞争力的顶级球员，他们有着坚强的心态。我喜欢这个，因为我正在学习。和这些类型的球员一起踢球是一种乐趣，因为当你和最好的球员一起踢球时，你就能进步。”搬到一个新的国家可能会令人畏惧，但查瓦里亚很快就找到了周围的人来帮助过渡。莫伊塞斯·凯塞多就是其中之一，随着佩普开始适应英格兰的生活，他扮演了重要的队友和老师的角色。 “莫伊一直陪伴着我，他现在教我英语，因为我需要学习，”查瓦里亚用他已经很流利的英语解释道。他每周都参加课程，并决心在赛季结束时能够说得流利。除了科巴姆，查瓦里亚也开始与家人和朋友一起探索新的环境，参观伦敦一些最著名的地标。 “第一天我忙于与家人和朋友相处。例如，我们去了白金汉宫、大本钟、伦敦眼。这是一座了不起的城市。不过目前，家距离科巴姆很近，这让他可以在伦敦的喧嚣和萨里乡村的安静环境之间享受平衡。对于一个以勤奋、耐心和不懈的进步愿望为基础建立职业生涯的球员来说，如此靠近训练场也许很合适。如果说查瓦里亚通往切尔西的道路不同寻常，那么他的比赛风格似乎非常适合英超联赛提出的挑战。他很快发现英格兰足球的强度适合他。 “我认为英超联赛现在是世界上最好的联赛，”他说。 “比赛强度很大，质量很高，而且球员都是顶级的。我认为对我来说，这是我能参加的最好的联赛，因为我是一个精力充沛的球员，我喜欢逐场比赛并为球队工作。查瓦里亚补充道，西甲联赛更加结构化、更具战术性。 “在这里，球员的素质更高，身体素质也更强。 “这里更困难，因为所有球队都有非常优秀的球员。表中的最后一支球队可以战胜第一支球队。因为你要和顶级选手比赛，所以你需要保持最佳水平，因为在这里，如果你不保持专注，一秒钟你就可能输掉比赛。你需要始终保持高度集中。另一个熟悉的元素标志着佩普在切尔西的旅程。和查瓦里亚一样，哈维·阿隆索的职业生涯也不是从西班牙足球顶级联赛开始的，这位未来的世界杯和欧洲杯冠军得主在西班牙乙级联赛的皇家社会 B 队开始了自己的职业生涯，之后才跻身足球界的精英行列。现在，两人正在切尔西一起工作，阿隆索希望利用帮助查瓦里亚进入斯坦福桥的品质。 “哈维是目前世界上最好的教练之一，”佩普说。 “我学到了很多东西，我知道他想帮助我。现在我正在学习，我的适应能力很好。我认为我可以做得更多，我可以进步。 “他希望我以充沛的精力进攻和防守。我们有很多解决方案。 我认为我们拥有一支非常完整的团队。对于一个从小就梦想达到最高水平的球员来说，在斯坦福桥穿上切尔西球衣不可避免地是一次特殊的经历。佩普在客场对阵富勒姆的比赛中首次代表我们出场，随后在卡拉宝杯战胜卢顿镇的比赛中首发出场，在那里他体验到了蓝桥内独特的氛围。 “这个体育场令人难以置信，”他说。 “当我还是个孩子的时候，我在电视上看过很多比赛。我记得那件事，现在我说：“哇，我在这里”。你真切地感受到能量和氛围。 “球迷们太棒了，我很高兴，因为我看到他们所有人，我说：‘哇’。球衣、球场，一切都令人难以置信，而且非常棒。 Chavarria 所取得的成就令人感到自豪，这是可以理解的。他曾效力于西班牙足球金字塔的各个级别，在加盟切尔西之前，他在西甲联赛中赢得了机会，并帮助俱乐部进入了欧洲决赛。他的职业生涯是建立在勇气和毅力的基础上的，他是通过队伍晋升的，而不是像如今经常发生的那样，通过学院晋升。所有这些都帮助他在性格和地位上成长，并使他成为世界冠军的故乡。现在他决心确保故事继续向上发展。 “我想赢得奖杯。这是我的目标，”他说。 “我希望获得欧冠资格。 “切尔西是世界上最好的俱乐部之一，总是需要每年赢得一座奖杯并参加欧洲冠军联赛。”他还有一个早已遥不可及，但现在已经触手可及的个人目标。 “首先，赢得奖杯，然后加入国家队，”他说道，然后添加了球队道德和成熟的标志：“但对我来说，最重要的是俱乐部。”对于一名必须在西班牙足球的每一步都不断攀登才能到达这里的球员来说，在西班牙队中占据一席之地将代表着另一个非凡的里程碑。但佩普知道，通往下一个梦想的道路始于他穿着蓝色的衣服。 “我认为我们会带来胜利，球迷们也会很高兴——很高兴赢得一些奖杯。”从菲格雷斯到奥洛特、萨拉戈萨和拉约·巴列卡诺，查瓦里亚已经证明耐心、决心和努力可以让他走得更远。现在，在斯坦福桥的超现实环境中，这段旅程的最新篇章才刚刚开始。

news.title: Chelsea Goal of the Month winner for September revealed!
news.title_zh: 切尔西九月最佳进球得主揭晓！
news.body_en: Morgan Rogers' brilliant strike against Arsenal has won Chelsea's September Goal of the Month award. The England international opened the scoring inside two minutes at the Emirates Stadium, meeting Jorrel Hato's header from a Reece James free-kick with a first-time finish into the bottom corner. Rogers hit the ball first-time flush on the volley beyond the despairing David Raya in the Arsenal goal to give us the perfect start in north London. Our No.17’s strike was the most popular among Blues fans, receiving 31 per cent of all votes cast. Cole Palmer's fine finish against Leeds United finished second with 25 per cent, while Joao Pedro's effort against Hull City took third place with 19 per cent.
news.body_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯对阵阿森纳的精彩进球为切尔西赢得了九月最佳进球奖。这位英格兰国脚在酋长球场开场不到两分钟就首开纪录，接住里斯·詹姆斯任意球的乔雷尔·哈托的头球攻入球门底角。罗杰斯在阿森纳进球时首次凌空抽射，超越了绝望的大卫·拉亚，为我们在北伦敦的比赛带来了完美的开局。我们的 17 号进球最受蓝军球迷欢迎，获得了 31% 的选票。科尔·帕尔默在对阵利兹联队的比赛中表现出色，以 25% 的命中率排名第二，而若奥·佩德罗在对阵赫尔城的比赛中的进球以 19% 的命中率排名第三。

news.title: Lucy Bronze withdraws from England camp with minor injury
news.title_zh: 露西·青铜因轻伤退出英格兰训练营
news.body_en: Lucy Bronze will return to Chelsea from England duty to manage a minor injury sustained in league action last weekend. The Blues recorded a 3-0 win over West Ham in the Women’s Super League on Sunday, and Bronze played the full match as captain of the side. Bronze has earned 148 caps for the Lionesses and won back-to-back European Championships in 2022 and 2025. She will now not be involved in this window, when England play Greece in a two-legged World Cup qualifier.
news.body_zh: 露西·布朗泽将从英格兰队返回切尔西，处理上周末联赛中受的轻伤。周日，蓝军在女超联赛中以3-0战胜西汉姆联，布隆泽作为球队队长踢满了整场比赛。青铜已经为母狮队出场 148 次，并在 2022 年和 2025 年连续赢得欧洲锦标赛冠军。她现在将不会参加英格兰队与希腊队进行两回合世界杯预选赛的这个窗口期。

news.title: Hazard added to Chelsea FC Legends squad vs Tottenham as tickets go on general sale
news.title_zh: 阿扎尔加入切尔西传奇对阵托特纳姆热刺的阵容，门票开始公开发售
news.body_en: Four-time Chelsea Player of the Year, Eden Hazard, will be returning to Stamford Bridge on Saturday 27 March. The Chelsea Legends versus Tottenham Legends match will take place on Easter Weekend and raise crucial funds for Chelsea Foundation and its work bringing people together, creating healthier lives and shaping brighter futures in our local communities. Hazard is undoubtedly one of the most popular and most skilful players ever to wear the Chelsea shirt. For this special game he will be back in the stadium where he created so many memories as he helped the team to domestic honours and European glory. Only this week, one of his solo strikes, scored against Arsenal, was voted Chelsea's Ultimate Goal of the Season by supporters. The Belgian superstar also has a notable past against Spurs, not least his famous equaliser in the 'Battle of the Bridge' a decade ago. Next March he will be reunited with two former team-mates, John Terry and Oscar, who have also been confirmed to play. Other returning legends are yet to be announced.  Tickets for the match which kicks off at 3pm on 27 March are now on general sale, up to 20 tickets per person. - Click to buy Chelsea Legends vs Tottenham Legends tickets Tickets will be sold online only and are subject to availability. All persons under the age of 16 will be required to attend the relevant area of the ground with, and sit in the ground next to, a person aged 18 years of age or over. Season ticket holders, True Blue+, True Blue and CFC Blue members can purchase tickets in Westview. All Club Chelsea ticket purchases are subject to Club Chelsea terms and conditions. Accessible season ticket holders and members can purchase tickets as outlined above via the application form available by clicking here or by phoning the access team on 0371 811 2012 or 0044 207 915 1950 (international callers). Supporters can click here to make an application for car parking from 10am on Wednesday 3 March. You will be required to display your Blue Badge while parked at Stamford Bridge. There will be no ticket exchange in operation for this fixture. Supporters who have a Ticket Forwarding Membership can receive tickets from a season ticket holder or True Blue+, True Blue or CFC Blue member up until 12pm on Saturday 27 March. Supporters will receive zero loyalty points for this match. Please note refund requests must reach the ticket office no later than 3pm on Saturday 20 March. The match will also provide support for Spurs in the Community. - Click to buy Chelsea Legends vs Tottenham Legends tickets

news.title: Chelsea FC announces new global partnership with GAC
news.title_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部宣布与广汽集团建立新的全球合作伙伴关系
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club today announces a global partnership with GAC – one of the world’s fastest growing global automotive businesses – which sees the company become the men’s team Official Automotive Partner. The partnership brings together Chelsea’s global football community and GAC’s growing global automotive business, creating closer connections with fans and consumers in the UK, across Europe and beyond. Chelsea FC has one of the largest global fan bases in the world with millions of supporters across Europe and beyond. GAC is one of China’s largest automobile manufacturers and the partnership comes at a time when GAC is expanding its global reach into new markets with its range of high-quality, practical models. GAC and Chelsea first joined forces for the 2026 pre-season tour and this new chapter together will see vehicles from GAC’s AION range escorting the men’s team to Stamford Bridge on selected matchdays. We will also collaborate on digital storytelling, fan experiences and engagement including car displays, providing opportunities for the Chelsea family to discover GAC and its vehicles. The UK and Europe are important markets in GAC’s international development. The partnership with Chelsea adds a new dimension to this work, complementing product introductions, sales-channel development and customer support. It will help GAC reach audiences beyond traditional automotive channels as the company continues to build its presence across the region. GAC’s European line-up includes the AION V electric SUV and the AION UT compact electric hatchback, offering options for family travel and everyday mobility. Both models reflect the company’s focus on practical usability, technology and quality. The partnership also forms part of GAC’s One GAC 2.0 global strategy and its Local for Local approach. By combining the partnership’s international reach with activities shaped around local interests, GAC and Chelsea will build lasting connections together with supporters and customers.
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部今天宣布与广汽集团（全球增长最快的汽车企业之一）建立全球合作伙伴关系，该公司成为男子足球队的官方汽车合作伙伴。此次合作将切尔西的全球足球界和广汽集团不断增长的全球汽车业务结合在一起，与英国、欧洲及其他地区的球迷和消费者建立更紧密的联系。切尔西足球俱乐部拥有世界上最大的全球球迷基础之一，在欧洲及其他地区拥有数百万支持者。广汽集团是中国最大的汽车制造商之一，此次合作正值广汽集团凭借一系列高品质、实用的车型将其全球影响力拓展到新市场之际。广汽和切尔西首次联手参加 2026 年季前赛，在这一新篇章中，广汽 AION 系列车辆将在选定的比赛日护送男队前往斯坦福桥。我们还将在数字故事讲述、粉丝体验和参与（包括汽车展示）方面进行合作，为切尔西家族提供发现广汽及其车辆的机会。英国和欧洲是广汽国际化发展的重要市场。与切尔西的合作为这项工作增添了新的维度，补充了产品介绍、销售渠道开发和客户支持。随着广汽集团继续在该地区建立影响力，它将帮助广汽集团接触到传统汽车渠道之外的受众。广汽集团的欧洲产品阵容包括AION V电动SUV和AION UT紧凑型电动掀背车，为家庭旅行和日常出行提供选择。这两种型号都体现了该公司对实用性、技术和质量的关注。此次合作也是 GAC One GAC 2.0 全球战略及其“本地服务本地”方法的一部分。通过将合作伙伴关系的国际影响力与围绕当地利益开展的活动相结合，广汽集团和切尔西将与支持者和客户建立持久的联系。

news.title: The Pride of London Collection: Inspired by our fans
news.title_zh: 伦敦之傲系列：灵感来自我们的粉丝
news.body_en: The vibrant environment of Stamford Bridge and a glance back at the fashions that filled the stands and terraces in the 1970s, 1980s and 1990s are the inspiration for a clothing collection launched today. It brings fan culture to the fore. The range incorporating jackets, tops, joggers, caps and a scarf in a mix of navy, lighter blue and bright white hues has pride across the club at its heart. The Pride of London Collection reflects what it means to watch our teams and the culture that shaped the club in the previous millennium, along with the attitude and passion that continues to this day. That is why we have chosen fans to model the leisure range for the launch today, and why Stamford Bridge is the only suitable backdrop to showcase the attire in situ and at its best. It is the Nineties that inspire the Pride of London parka jacket whose standout features are a check lining and an embroidered Chelsea crest from the era. Both that jacket and the navy ribbed-knit jumper have interchangeable badges on the sleeves. There is also a ‘90s feel to the two t-shirt designs which again display a Chelsea badge proudly, and to the loose-fit jogging bottoms. A further step back to the Eighties is greeted by the collection’s Harrington jacket which also has a check design for the lining and sleeve badges which are interchangeable. The same decade’s supporter culture is the inspiration for the relaxed fit of the quarter-zip sweat top. Completing the collection are the Pride of London polo shirt which comes in white with darker collar and sleeve trim, plus two styles of cap and a lambswool check scarf with a woven patch. This collection is a modern look for a feeling that has never left Stamford Bridge. Shop it now in the online store or visit the Megastore at the stadium.
news.body_zh: 斯坦福桥充满活力的环境以及 1970 年代、1980 年代和 1990 年代看台和看台上的时尚回顾，是今天推出的服装系列的灵感来源。它使粉丝文化脱颖而出。该系列包括夹克、上衣、慢跑裤、帽子和围巾，混合了海军蓝、浅蓝色和亮白色的色调，是整个俱乐部的骄傲。伦敦之傲系列反映了观看我们球队的意义以及在上个千年塑造俱乐部的文化，以及延续至今的态度和热情。这就是为什么我们选择了粉丝来为今天的发布休闲系列做模特，也是为什么斯坦福桥是唯一合适的背景来现场展示服装的最佳状态。伦敦之傲派克大衣的灵感源自九十年代，其突出特点是格纹衬里和那个时代的刺绣切尔西徽章。这件夹克和海军蓝罗纹针织毛衣的袖子上都有可互换的徽章。两款 T 恤设计以及宽松的慢跑裤也充满了 90 年代的感觉，它们再次自豪地展示了切尔西徽章。该系列的 Harrington 夹克进一步回归八十年代，其衬里和袖子徽章也采用格子设计，可互换。同一十年的支持者文化为宽松版型的四分之一拉链运动上衣提供了灵感。该系列还包括 Pride of London Polo 衫，颜色为白色，衣领和袖子饰边较深，另外还有两种款式的帽子和带有编织贴片的羊羔毛格纹围巾。该系列采用现代外观，营造出斯坦福桥从未离开过的感觉。立即在网上商店购买或访问体育场的 Megastore。

news.title: Ellie Carpenter wins 2026 Australian PFA Women's Footballer of the Year
news.title_zh: 艾莉·卡彭特 (Ellie Carpenter) 荣获 2026 年澳大利亚 PFA 年度最佳女子足球先生
news.body_en: Chelsea's Ellie Carpenter has been recognised for an outstanding 12 months after her fellow Australian professionals voted her PFA Women's Footballer of the Year for 2025/26. The award caps a memorable year for the Australian international, who made a big impact in her first season with the Blues, lifting the League Cup. She also played a key role for the Matildas as they reached the final of the AFC Women's Asian Cup on home soil. 'I'm very honoured to receive this award,' Ellie said. 'It's always special when you get voted by your peers and your team-mates. It's a very special award to win, and I'm very honoured and proud of my year.' The 26-year-old made 29 appearances for Chelsea in all competitions during the 2025/26 campaign, including 27 starts, scoring three goals and providing three assists. Her impressive club campaign was complemented by a memorable year with Australia, where she won a silver medal at the Asian Cup in March. The tournament also marked a milestone in her international career as she earned her 100th cap in the semi-final win over China, becoming a centurion at the age of 25. For Carpenter, though, the significance of the PFA honour comes from the fact it is recognition from those she shares the pitch with. 'When you're part of a team,  it's nice that they think that you're doing well and helping the team succeed and win games,' she said. 'It feels really special to be thought about like that by your team-mates and peers, for club and country. So yeah, I'm very proud and honoured.' The accolade also reflects Carpenter's impressive adaptation after moving to London and joining Chelsea, with the defender acknowledging the challenge of adjusting to a new league while preparing for a major international tournament. 'During the last 12 months, I moved to London here at Chelsea,' she continued. 'We had the Asian Cup for Australia. So, two big things that happened last season. It was about adapting to a new league here and also a major tournament during a season. It was quite tricky to navigate at times. 'But I'm proud of how I adapted and also learned and grew as well in the last year and with the season. So yeah, I'm also proud of my performances.' There were plenty of personal milestones along the way, including her first appearance for the Blues and her first goal for the club. 'One highlight is making my debut for Chelsea,' Carpenter reflected. 'It was a great debut season for me and scoring my first goal for the club as well. Making it to the Asian Cup final was a great achievement for us as a team. We fell short in the end, but we captured the nation again and had a great, successful tournament at home in Australia.' Carpenter has carried that form into the new campaign, starting every game so far as we remain unbeaten in both the Women's Super League and Champions League. With another big season ahead at club level and the 2027 Women's World Cup in Brazil on the horizon, the Australian is excited about what comes next. 'I'm looking forward to this season with Chelsea, to building on last season personally and also as a team,' she said. 'Winning is an objective of ours, and we're just taking it game by game and hopefully finishing better than last season. 'And also with my country, we have a huge preparation before the World Cup in Brazil. So I'm focusing on being the best individual I can be for the team, for Australia, building on those relationships with my country and preparing for the World Cup.' See Ellie in our London derby against Spurs at the Bridge! Tickets for that match on Sunday 18 October are on sale now...
news.body_zh: 切尔西队球员艾莉·卡彭特 (Ellie Carpenter) 在澳大利亚专业人士投票选出 2025/26 年度 PFA 年度最佳女足运动员后 12 个月内表现出色，获得了认可。对于这位澳大利亚国脚来说，这一奖项是值得纪念的一年，她在蓝军的第一个赛季就产生了巨大的影响，举起了联赛杯。她还在玛蒂尔达队在本土闯入亚足联女子亚洲杯决赛的过程中发挥了关键作用。 “我非常荣幸获得这个奖项，”艾莉说。 “当你得到同事和队友的投票时，这总是很特别的。这是一个非常特别的奖项，我对自己的这一年感到非常荣幸和自豪。”这位26岁的球员在2025/26赛季为切尔西各项赛事出场29次，其中27次首发，打进3球并提供3次助攻。她令人印象深刻的俱乐部生涯与在澳大利亚度过的难忘的一年相得益彰，她在三月份的亚洲杯上获得了银牌。这场比赛也标志着她国际职业生涯的一个里程碑，她在半决赛战胜中国队的比赛中第 100 次代表国家队出场，并在 25 岁时成为百夫长。不过，对于卡彭特来说，PFA 荣誉的重要性在于它是来自与她同场竞技的人的认可。 “当你成为团队的一员时，他们认为你做得很好并帮助团队取得成功并赢得比赛，这很好，”她说。 “对于俱乐部和国家队来说，被你的队友和同侪如此看待，感觉真的很特别。所以，是的，我非常自豪和荣幸。这一荣誉也反映了卡彭特在移居伦敦并加盟切尔西后令人印象深刻的适应能力，这位后卫承认在准备重大国际赛事的同时适应新联赛的挑战。 “在过去的 12 个月里，我搬到了伦敦切尔西，”她继续说道。 “我们为澳大利亚队举办了亚洲杯。所以，上赛季发生了两件大事。这是为了适应这里的新联赛以及赛季中的重要赛事。有时导航非常棘手。 “但我为自己在去年和整个赛季的适应、学习和成长感到自豪。所以，是的，我也为自己的表现感到自豪。一路上有很多个人里程碑，包括她第一次代表蓝军出场和为俱乐部打进第一个进球。 “其中一个亮点是我为切尔西首次亮相，”卡彭特回忆道。 “这对我来说是一个伟大的处子赛季，也为俱乐部打进了我的第一个进球。进入亚洲杯决赛对于我们作为一支球队来说是一项伟大的成就。我们最终落败，但我们再次赢得了全国冠军，并在澳大利亚主场举办了一场伟大而成功的比赛。”卡彭特将这种状态带入了新赛季，到目前为止，我们在女超联赛和欧冠联赛中都保持不败，每场比赛都首发。随着俱乐部层面又一个重要赛季的到来，以及 2027 年巴西女足世界杯的临近，澳大利亚人对接下来发生的事情感到兴奋。 “我期待着切尔西的这个赛季，我个人和球队都将在上赛季的基础上再接再厉，”她说。 “获胜是我们的目标，我们只是一场一场地对待，希望能比上赛季取得更好的成绩。 “对于我的国家来说，我们在巴西世界杯之前也做了大量的准备工作。因此，我专注于成为球队、澳大利亚的最佳人选，与我的国家建立良好的关系，并为世界杯做准备。”看看埃莉在桥上对阵热刺的伦敦德比吧！ 10 月 18 日星期日那场比赛的门票现已发售......

news.body_en: We celebrate Pedro's Chelsea career after our brilliant former winger announced his retirement from the game. It was 11 years ago that Chelsea secured a major coup by signing the venerable Pedro from Barcelona. At that point the most decorated player to ever represent the Blues, the Spaniard went on to enjoy a stellar five-year career at Stamford Bridge. It was rare for any game to pass Pedro by and in his 206 appearances for us he scored 43 goals and provided 28 assists. So many of those came at significant moments; plenty were of elite quality. Indeed, of those 43 goals, Pedro scored more with his supposedly weaker left foot (21 to 18), testament to his all-round ability and deftness of touch. Watch his best Blues goals in the video below – you’ll notice the variety of finish and foot involved! Pedro departed Chelsea in the summer of 2020, at the end of a season elongated by the pandemic, and in which he captained the Blues for the first time and brought up 200 appearances for the club. ‘He’s been an incredible servant,’ then head coach Frank Lampard said after Pedro’s last game in a Chelsea shirt. ‘The impact he has had here has been huge.’ Alongside the goals, the facts and figures also help do justice to the Chelsea career of Pedro, who is still going strong with Lazio in Serie A aged 38. Here are some of the best! Chelsea debut: West Bromwich Albion (a) 23.08.15. Won 3-2, scored the opening goal Chelsea career: 260 appearances, 43 goals Selected in UEFA’s Europa League 2018/19 squad of the season Runners-up medals: FA Cup 2017 and 2020, FA Community Shield 2017 and 2018, League Cup 2019, UEFA Super Cup 2019 100th appearance vs Liverpool (a) - 25 November 2017, substitute for Tiemoue Bakayoko. Drew 1-1 200th appearance vs Liverpool (h) - FA Cup 3 March 2020. Won 2-0 International honours: 2010 World Cup winner, Euro 2012 winner, 2013 Confederations Cup runner-up Major international tournaments: 2010 World Cup (2+3 games), Euro 2012 (3 games), 2014 World Cup (1+1 games), Euro 2016 (0+2 games) International recognition: Spain 65 caps, 17 goals, Under-21s two caps International caps won with Chelsea: Spain 14 caps, one goal Chelsea never lost when Pedro scored for the Blues. He scored 43 goals and in the 39 games he found the net, we won 37 and drew two. Our 1000th Premier League goal at Stamford Bridge was scored by Pedro against Fulham in 2018/19.
news.body_zh: 在我们杰出的前边锋宣布退役后，我们庆祝佩德罗的切尔西职业生涯。 11年前，切尔西从巴塞罗那签下德高望重的佩德罗，取得了重大成功。这位西班牙人当时是代表蓝军获得最多荣誉的球员，随后在斯坦福桥度过了辉煌的五年职业生涯。很少有比赛能超越佩德罗，在他为我们出场的 206 场比赛中，他攻入 43 粒进球并贡献 28 次助攻。其中许多都是在重要时刻发生的；很多都是精英品质。事实上，在这 43 个进球中，佩德罗用他被认为较弱的左脚打进了更多进球（21 比 18），证明了他的全面能力和灵巧的触球能力。在下面的视频中观看他的最佳蓝军进球 - 您会注意到射门和脚部的变化！佩德罗于 2020 年夏天离开切尔西，当时他的赛季因疫情而延长，他首次担任蓝军队长，并为俱乐部出场 200 场。 “他是一位令人难以置信的仆人，”时任主教练弗兰克·兰帕德在佩德罗穿着切尔西球衣参加最后一场比赛后说道。 “他在这里产生了巨大的影响。”除了进球之外，事实和数据也有助于公正地评价佩德罗的切尔西职业生涯，38 岁的佩德罗仍在意甲拉齐奥队中表现强劲。以下是一些最好的！切尔西首秀：西布罗姆维奇 (客) 2015 年 8 月 23 日。 3-2 获胜，打进首球 切尔西生涯：出场 260 场，进 43 球 入选欧足联 2018/19 赛季欧洲联赛最佳阵容 亚军奖牌：2017 年和 2020 年足总杯、2017 年和 2018 年社区盾杯、2019 年联赛杯、2019 年欧洲超级杯 第 100 次出场对阵利物浦 (客场) - 2017年11月25日，替补巴卡约科。第 200 场比赛 1-1 对阵利物浦（主） - 足总杯，2020 年 3 月 3 日。以 2-0 获胜 国际荣誉：2010 年世界杯冠军、2012 年欧洲杯冠军、2013 年联合会杯亚军 主要国际赛事：2010 年世界杯（2+3 场）、2012 年欧洲杯（3 场）、2014 年世界杯（1+1）场），2016 年欧洲杯（0+2 场） 国际认可度： 为西班牙队出场 65 次，攻入 17 个进球，21 岁以下青年队出场 2 次 与切尔西一起赢得国际比赛：为西班牙队出场 14 次，攻入一球 当佩德罗为蓝军进球时，切尔西从未输过。他打进了 43 个进球，在他进球的 39 场比赛中，我们赢了 37 场，平了 2 场。我们在斯坦福桥的第 1000 个英超进球是佩德罗在 2018/19 赛季对阵富勒姆的比赛中攻入的。

news.body_en: September saw Chelsea Women score 11 goals in seven matches and now you can vote for your favourite to decide the winner of our Chelsea Women's Constant Contact Goal of the Month award. During a spectacular month, we went unbeaten as the new domestic campaign and the league phase of the UEFA Women's Champions League got under way. Four Women's Super League wins and one draw since the start of the season have seen us collect 13 points, sitting second in the table, while a win and a draw in the Champions League have made it a fine start to our European campaign. The month began with qualification for the Champions League proper, with a 1-0 away win against Real Sociedad, followed quickly by a 1-1 draw with Aston Villa to kick off the new WSL campaign. That was backed up with four wins on the trot over Manchester United, Birmingham City, Austria Vienna and, in the stand-out result, a 1-0 victory over rivals Arsenal. September ended with a hard-fought goalless draw in the Champions League away at Lyonnes. Which Chelsea goal in September was your favourite? You can view the shortlisted strikes above and then submit your vote over on the Chelsea Official App, where the winner of the award, presented by Constant Contact, will be revealed in the coming days. James scored the opening goal of our league campaign with a fine strike. Receiving the ball 25 yards from goal, she showed some nifty footwork, rolling the ball twice under her studs before a step-over created space against the defender, allowing her to rifle a rasping left-footed effort into the roof of the net beyond the despairing goalkeeper. German midfielder Nusken opened her WSL account for the season with the first goal of the match against Manchester United after some excellent build-up play from Wieke Kaptein. Kaptein took advantage of a defensive lapse from Man Utd as the ball bounced over Dominique Janssen's head. She showed exquisite control to bring it down, then great vision to lay it off to Nusken, who did the rest with a calm side-footed finish into the far corner. On her 50th appearance for the Blues, Walsh grabbed a goal and an assist to cap a fine day. The midfielder let fly with a powerful drive into the bottom corner to make it 2-0 and hand us a firm grip on the match. After Man United failed to clear a dangerous cross, Lucy Bronze laid the ball off to Walsh, who took one touch to set herself before letting rip from the edge of the area with an unstoppable effort into the bottom corner. James' second entry of the month comes courtesy of her second-half strike against Man United. A fine touch and cutting through-ball from Walsh took three Man United players out of the game, and James did the rest with an excellent left-footed effort across the goalkeeper and into the far corner of the net. The Australian grabbed her first goal of the season, being the first to react to a loose ball after the Man United goalkeeper saved her initial effort, following good work from Kaptein to set up the chance. The Dutch midfielder's strong tackle and run through the middle of the park opened things up for Carpenter on the right to hit a first-time effort, only to see it saved before the Aussie fired in the rebound beyond the desperate Man United defence. It was a moment of magic from Potter to give us the lead early on against Birmingham when the midfielder took a fabulous first touch in the box before smashing the ball into the roof of the net from 10 yards out. With two defenders throwing themselves in front of her, Potter knew she had to risk going high, and did so in style, smashing an unsaveable effort into the top of the net after fine work by Carpenter down the right to set up the chance. French star Malard came off the bench to put the game to bed against Birmingham with a lovely finish. Latching onto a poor header back from the Birmingham defence, Malard's first touch dinked the ball over the onrushing goalkeeper and her second was on the volley to finish into the empty net. Kaptein's stupendous strike was the difference in our opening Champions League match, with the Dutch star rifling in a long-range effort to settle the match 1-0. Kaptein picked up a loose ball 30 yards from goal, took two touches to beat the lunging defender and set herself up to thunder a shot off the underside of the crossbar. The American winger sealed all three points in the London derby against Arsenal with a poacher's finish to grab the only goal of the game. After some battling work from Kaptein, Carpenter and Malard to win the ball back, Walsh's powerful strike could only be parried by goalkeeper Anneke Borbe, and Thompson was first to react and fire in from a tight angle.
news.body_zh: 9 月份，切尔西女足在 7 场比赛中攻入 11 个进球，现在您可以投票选出您最喜欢的球员，以决定切尔西女足本月最佳持续接触进球奖的获得者。在精彩的一个月里，随着新的国内赛事和欧洲女子冠军联赛联赛阶段的展开，我们保持不败。赛季开始以来，女超联赛4胜1平，积13分，排名第二，欧冠联赛1胜1平，为欧战开局。这个月以欧冠资格开始，客场 1-0 战胜皇家社会，随后又 1-1 战平阿斯顿维拉，拉开了新赛季 WSL 的序幕。球队四次战胜曼联、伯明翰城、奥地利维也纳，并以 1-0 战胜对手阿森纳，为这一成绩提供了有力支持。九月份的冠军联赛客场与里昂进行了一场苦战，双方互交白卷。切尔西九月份的哪个进球是你最喜欢的？您可以查看上面入围的进球，然后在切尔西官方应用程序上提交您的投票，由 Constant Contact 颁发的奖项获奖者将在未来几天内揭晓。詹姆斯凭借一记漂亮的进球为我们联赛打进了首球。在距球门 25 码处接球时，她展现了一些漂亮的步法，在脚下将球滚了两圈，然后跨步为防守队员创造了空间，让她在绝望的守门员之外将一记粗暴的左脚射入网顶。德国中场球员努斯肯在维克·卡普坦的出色发挥后，在对阵曼联的比赛中攻入第一个进球，开启了她本赛季的 WSL 账户。卡普坦利用了曼联的防守失误，皮球从多米尼克·扬森的头上弹过。她展现出了精湛的控球能力，将球传给了努斯肯，后者以冷静的侧脚射门将球打入远角。沃尔什为蓝军出场第 50 次，她攻入一球并贡献一次助攻，为美好的一天画上圆满的句号。这位中场球员一脚大力射入球门底角，将比分改写为2-0，让我们牢牢掌握了比赛的主动权。在曼联未能清除危险的传中后，露西·布朗泽将球传给沃尔什，沃尔什触球后定位球，然后从禁区边缘以势不可挡的射门将球打入球门底角。詹姆斯本月的第二场比赛是在对阵曼联的下半场进球中取得的。沃尔什的一脚漂亮的触球和切入球让三名曼联球员退出了比赛，而詹姆斯则用一脚出色的左脚射门越过了门将并射入了球网远角。这位澳大利亚人打进了她本赛季的第一个进球，在卡普坦的出色表现后，曼联门将扑出了她最初的射门，她成为第一个对失球作出反应的人。这位荷兰中场的强力拦截和穿过公园中央的跑动为右路的卡彭特打开了机会，他第一次射门，但在澳大利亚人在绝望的曼联防守之外射门反弹之前被扑出。在对阵伯明翰的比赛中，波特的神奇时刻让我们早早取得领先，这位中场球员在禁区内完成了一次精彩的触球，然后从 10 码外将球击入了球门。当两名防守队员挡在她面前时，波特知道她必须冒着风险去顶高，所以她的做法很有风格，在卡彭特右路的出色表现创造了机会后，她将一记无法挽救的射门打入网顶。法国球星马拉德替补出场，以漂亮的进球结束了对阵伯明翰的比赛。马拉德接住伯明翰后防线的一记糟糕的头球回攻，第一次触球就将球打在了冲上来的门将身上，第二次则是凌空抽射，将球打进了空门。卡普坦的精彩射门为我们在欧冠首场比赛中带来了不同，这位荷兰球星的远射将比赛定为1-0。卡普坦在距离球门 30 码处接到一个松散的球，两次触球击败了猛冲过来的防守球员，然后从横梁下方一脚劲射。这位美国边锋在与阿森纳的伦敦德比中全取三分，并以偷猎者的射门打进了全场唯一进球。 在卡普坦、卡彭特和马拉德奋力拼抢后，沃尔什的大力射门只能被门将安内克·博贝挡开，汤普森第一个做出反应，从一个小角度射门。

news.body_en: We are delighted to announce the upcoming release of a brand-new documentary, coming exclusively to CFC+ on 15 October. Following the release of Samba Blues in February, which celebrated the powerful connection between Chelsea and Brazil, our latest release focuses on the story of our brilliant young Brazilian. I Am Estevao charts the unique journey of Estevao Willian from the city of Franca in south-east Brazil, through the Santos and Palmeiras youth systems, to arriving in London and that incredible goal against Barcelona. There is exclusive input from Estevao’s family and early coaches, who describe the boy who would become the man we see in Blue today, as well as from Chelsea legends such as Thiago Silva and David Luiz. Estevao also provides an insight into why he chose Chelsea, playing against his future employees at the 2025 FIFA Club World Cup and what Cole Palmer said to him after that game. The full documentary will be released on 15 October and is available exclusively on CFC+. You can get more information on CFC+ and subscribe here now. Beyond I Am Estevao, CFC+ brings you even more exclusive Chelsea content all year round, including: Every episode of CFC Unlocked, featuring in-depth conversations with the likes of Morgan Rogers, Cole Palmer and Reece James Live Cobham Next Gen and Chelsea Under-18s matches Selected live training sessions Iconic games from the archive Original series and boxsets throughout the season

news.body_en: The dates and kick-off times for Chelsea Women's home fixtures against Everton and Manchester City, as well as our away trip to Liverpool, have now been confirmed.
